name: manual_1ead9e
claim: Land follow-up work as one branch and one PR per repository, and do not delete a stacked PR's base branch after merging.

decisions.notes: Deleting a merged base auto-closed the PR stacked on it and cost a re-opened PR; consolidated follow-ups removed merge-order ambiguity.

rationale: Deleting a merged base auto-closed the PR stacked on it and cost a re-opened PR; consolidated follow-ups removed merge-order ambiguity.
